voice.note: speaker → script/cast.json (voice, speed, pitch). Per line: speed (× the speaker's), pre/post (ms of silence before/after the voice), say (what is spoken, if not `text`), estVoice (s: the predicted voice length, tools/estimate.py; replaced by the real voice once tools/voice.py has run).

source: Mahabharata, Critical Edition (BORI), Adi Parva, Pauloma sub-parva, adhyayas 6 (end) and 7: Bhrigu curses Agni: you shall eat everything (sarvabhaksha); Agni answers in anger that, asked, he told the truth: a witness who knowingly speaks falsely ruins seven generations of his line before and after; he could curse Bhrigu in return but honours brahmins; he is the mouth through which gods and ancestors are fed; he withdraws from the fire-offerings, sacrifices and rites, and without the sacred calls all creatures suffer; the sages go to the gods and the gods to Brahma; Brahma calls Agni and speaks gently: he will not eat all things with his whole body, and as everything touched by the sun's rays becomes pure, whatever his flames burn will be pure; Agni agrees and returns, and gods and sages rejoice. Bhrigu's and Agni's speeches are condensed paraphrase. UNCERTAIN: "eat everything" renders sarvabhaksha; the gloss "pure and impure" is not spoken here.
structure: From episode 41 (the step-up; script/ARC-41-50.md): COLD OPEN (≤ 8 words, spoken by ≤ 2.8 s; the hook style rotates and never repeats the episode before) → title (hook post) → STORY from ≈ 4.5 s with the UNVOICED recap band → the episode stands alone (every name has an identifier in "names", shown as a plaque) → one question closed (loop.answeredBy), the previous one answered by 15 s (loop.prevAnsweredBy) → turn at 40–60 % after a real silence, a second silence where the story allows → one face close-up with a change of emotion → one signature shot → the cliffhanger with the source line → a ≤ 1.2 s NEXT › band that dissolves into frame 1. Per line: pal (the colour script: no hue for more than two lines), cam (≥ 4 distinct moves), tr (transitions born from the medium), amb / foley / music (three sound layers; ambLead / ambLag = J- and L-cuts). Gate: tools/gate.mjs.

names.Agni: the fire, witness of every rite

loop.prevQuestion: What does it mean to curse fire itself?
loop.openQuestion: How did one of Bhrigu's line lose his bride to a snake?

strings.recapLine: A sage's wife was carried off. The fire had told the truth.

lines.note: COLD OPEN (a question card over the answer image): a fire on its altar against lapis night, eating wood, cloth, a garland, a bone, each flaring; the card to the left of the flames, upright.

lines.text: The fire, Agni, told a demon the truth, and a sage's wife was carried off.
lines.say: The fire, [p:60] Agni, [p:60] told a demon the truth, [p:150] and a sage's wife was carried off.
lines.note: STORY 0 with the unvoiced recap band (top): the hut's fire with its face; in its smoke, the boar and the woman (a memory, one image).

lines.speaker: bhrigu
lines.note: STORY 1 · THE CLOSE-UP: Bhrigu's face, wrath (brow down, mouth open), then the arm thrown forward and the water from his pot (plaque: Bhrigu · a great sage). Pays off episode 42's last line by 6 s.

lines.speaker: agni
lines.text: "I was asked. I told the truth. A lying witness ruins seven generations."
lines.say: I was asked. [p:200] I told the truth. [p:300] A lying witness [p:80] ruins seven generations.
lines.note: STORY 2: the fire's face, hurt and steady; behind it, seven faint figures in a row dim one by one on "seven generations".

lines.text: Then Agni withdrew from every altar and every rite.
lines.say: Then Agni withdrew [p:100] from every altar [p:60] and every rite.
lines.note: STORY 3 · after a real silence · THE SIGNATURE SHOT · NEW LIGHT, the world without fire (cold-slate, almost colourless): a crane up over a land of altars and hearths; flame after flame goes out, far to near, each leaving a thread of grey smoke.

lines.text: No offering rose. The whole world suffered.
lines.say: No offering rose. [p:250] The whole world suffered.
lines.note: STORY 4: priests with ladles over cold altars; a family round a dead hearth; a lateral track past them, their breath showing.

lines.text: The sages went to the gods, and the gods to Brahma.
lines.say: The sages went to the gods, [p:120] and the gods to Brahma.
lines.note: STORY 5 · NEW LIGHT, Brahma's court (brahma-rose, a lotus sky): a tilt up from the grey earth through cloud to the rose-gold court: sages, then gods, then Brahma on his lotus (plaque: Brahma · the creator).

lines.speaker: brahma
lines.text: "Not all of you will eat all things. And whatever your flames burn will be made pure."
lines.say: Not all of you [p:60] will eat all things. [p:300] And whatever your flames burn [p:100] will be made pure.
lines.note: STORY 6 · THE TURN (≈ 55 %) after a real silence: Brahma, calm, a hand open toward a small dark flame that stands before him; on "pure" the flame turns clear gold-white, as the sun's rays make clean what they touch (the text's own likeness, shown as a ray falling on it). The word of the turn: PURE.

lines.text: So Agni returned, and the fires were lit again.
lines.say: So Agni returned, [p:120] and the fires were lit again.
lines.note: STORY 8 · NEW LIGHT (pure-flame: clear gold on lapis): the hearths and altars light again, near to far, in the reverse of the signature shot; people lift their hands.

lines.speaker: sauti
lines.text: So fire eats everything, and what it burns is clean.
lines.say: So fire eats everything, [p:200] and what it burns [p:60] is clean.
lines.note: FRAME (answers the hook): Sauti by the Naimisha fire at first light, a hand open to the flames; Shaunaka listening.

lines.text: Generations later, one of Bhrigu's line lost his bride to a snake.
lines.say: Generations later, [p:120] one of Bhrigu's line [p:80] lost his bride to a snake.
lines.note: NEXT 1 (the catalog's cliffhanger): a meadow path at dusk gone violet: a girl's anklet in the foreground grass, out of focus; the focus racks to a small banded snake asleep across the path. The source line (top).
The NEXT › band over the cliffhanger image, with the source line; dissolve into frame 1.
